questions.question:
What is the value of

-77 + 800 ÷ [83 - {8 × 9 + (18 - 3 × 5)}] = ?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

- 77 + 800 ÷ [83 - {8 × 9 + (18 - 3 × 5)}]

**Concept Used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule as given in the table below

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c660164b6fcbf7fccde8581574db1c60c2f06a73c1388107daf81a1fe8ec1ec0.png] 

**Calculation:**

Considering the given equation expression

- 77 + 800 ÷ [83 - {8 × 9 + (18 - 3 × 5)}]

⇒ -77 + 800 ÷ [83 - {8 × 9 + (18 - 15)}]

⇒ -77 + 800 ÷ [83 - {72 + 3}]

⇒ -77 + 800 ÷ 8

⇒ -77 + 100

⇒ 23

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**

 2) from 2009 to 2010 = 1.3​

questions.question: The average age of a man and his son is 60 years. The ratio of their ages is 13 : 7, respectively. What is the son's age?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of a man and his son is 60 years.

The ratio of their ages is 13 : 7, respectively.

**Formula used:**

Average = (Total sum)/(Total number)

Share in ratio = (individual value in ratio)/(Total sum of ratio values)

**Calculation:**

Sum of ages of a man and his son = 60 × 2 = 120 years

The ratio of their ages = 13: 7

⇒ 7/20 × 120 = 42 years

**∴ Age of son is 42 years.**

questions.question: Antony and Vikash together can complete a piece of work in 20 days and Vikash alone can complete it in 25 days. In how many days can Antony alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Ans: 3**

**Given: **

Antony and Vikash together can complete a piece of work in 20 days.

Vikash alone can complete it in 25 days.

**Formula used:**

one day work = 1/total days taken to complete the work

**Calculation:**

Antony's and Vikash's one day work = 1/20

Vikash's one day work = 1/25

Antony's one day work = 1/20 - 1/25

⇒ (5-4)/100 = 1/100

**∴ Antony will complete the work in 100 days.**

questions.question: How many minutes does Shyam take to cover a distance of 500 m if he runs at a speed of 30 km/h?
questions.solution:
**Ans: 4**

**Given:**

distance = 500m, speed = 30 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

First, we change speed in meter/minute

⇒ S = (30 × 1000)/60

⇒ 500 meter/minute

Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ 500/500 = 1 minute

**∴ Shyam will take 1 minute to cover this distance.**

questions.question: Two circles with centers P and Q of radii 7 cm nd 3 cm, respectively, touch each other externally at a point A. BC is a direct common tangent to these two circles where B and C are the points on the circles respectively. The length of BC is:
questions.solution:
**Given**

The radii of both circles are 3 cm and 7 cm

Both circles touch each other at point A externally

BC is the common tangent of both circles.

**Calculation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/247e5ced394954d14f6971f7f27b28bab8d2e28c378744ebdc5a3215c0933ff3.png] 

Join P to Q and B. Join Q to C. Draw PM ⊥ CQ.

Now PM = BC, as they are opposite sides of rectangle PMBC.

⇒ PQ = PA +AM

⇒ 7 cm + 3 cm

⇒ 10 cm.

⇒ QM = CQ – CM

⇒ 7 cm – 3cm

⇒ 4 cm

⇒ PM = √{(PQ)² - (QM)²}

⇒ √{(10)² - (4)²} 

⇒ 2√ 21

⇒ PM = BC

⇒ 2√ 21 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 2√ 21 cm.**

questions.question: If cot A = tan(2A - 45°), A is an acute angle then tan A is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given**

cot A = tan(2A - 45°)

**Concept**

cot A = tan(90° - A)

**Calculation**

⇒ cot A = tan(2A - 45°)

⇒ tan(90° - A) = tan(2A - 45°)

⇒ 90° - A = 2A - 45° 

⇒ A = 45° 

⇒ tan A = tan 45° = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

questions.question: If the breadth and perimeter of a rectangle are in the ratio 1 : 8 and the area of rectangle is 363 cm², then the breadth of the rectangle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of breadth and perimeter of rectangle = 1 : 8

Area of the Given rectangle = 363 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(length + breadth)

Area of Rectangle = length × breadth

**Calculation:**

Let the breadth be 1x and perimeter be 8x

Length of rectangle = l cm

Breadth of rectangle = b cm

2(l + b) = 8x

⇒ 2(l + x) = 8x

⇒ 2l = 8x – 2x = 6x

⇒ l = 3x cm

Now,

3x × x = 363 cm²

⇒ 3x² = 363 cm²

⇒ x = √121 cm

⇒ x = 11 cm

Since x is the value of breadth of rectangle therefore,

Breadth = x = 11 cm

**∴**** The Breadth of Rectangle is 11 cm.**

questions.question: The tangent at a point A of a circle with centre O intersects the diameter PQ of the circle (when extended) at the point B. If ∠BAP = 125°, then ∠AQP is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A circle with center O and diameter PQ extended outside the circle to point B

∠BAP = 125°

**Concept Used:**

Angle formed between radius and tangent of a circle is always 90°

Angles opposite to equal sides are equal.

Sum of two opposite interior angles of a triangle is equal to the opposite exterior angle.

Sum of all angles of triangle is 180°

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/448c1a81df5301d2c8370fb3ff5373bb257ef0afaad4d494b08f4d9816fe1762.png] 

OA ⊥ BA (Angle between Radius and Tangent)

∠OAP = ∠BAP - ∠OAB

⇒ ∠OAP = 125° - 90° = 35°

Since,

OA = OP = OQ (Radius of circle)

So,

∠OAP = ∠OPA = 35°

∠AOQ = ∠OAP + ∠OPA

⇒ ∠AOQ = 35° + 35° = 70°

In Δ AOQ,

∠AOQ = 70°

∠OAQ = ∠OQA (since OA = OQ)

∠AOQ + ∠OAQ + ∠OQA = 180°

⇒ 70° + ∠OAQ + ∠OQA = 180°

⇒ ∠OAQ + ∠OQA = 180° - 70° = 110°

⇒ 2∠OQA = 110°/2 = 55°

Since ∠OQA is the same angle as ∠AQP

∠AQP = 55°

**∴**** The value of ****∠****AQP = 55° **
